falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as the prior bottom structure would be violated rather than replicated

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score of 40 suggests controlled de-risking; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling and systemic stress, contradicting the 'bottom' pattern which featured VIX peaking near 28-30 before reversal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-quality of that magnitude signals recession/depression pricing rather than soft-landing bottom formation, invalidating the macro regime match to August 2024 which occurred alongside stable/rising yields

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
